title: AI Memory Field
subtitle: an open comparison of memory layers for LLM agents
method: 4-slice parallel census (OSS libraries, hosted SaaS, framework-native + MCP, KG/PKM/research) + palace looking-glass recon; deduped; unverifiable entrants dropped; GitHub metrics auto-pulled at build time.

categories.framework: memory subsystem inside an agent framework

notes: Stars and last-activity are pulled live from the GitHub API at build time; SaaS-only products without a public repo show no stars.
Neutral resource: rows are not ranked editorially; default sort is GitHub stars (a popularity proxy, not a quality judgment).
memory_model is a simplified primary tag; many tools are hybrid. Licenses/pricing verified at curation date and can drift.
Framework-native entries (LangMem, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, Haystack) and the MCP reference server show stars for the parent project/monorepo, not the memory feature in isolation.
Cells are tagged by evidence class: FACT (verifiable from repo, license, docs) and CLAIM (vendor self-reported, caveated).
Benchmark figures are self-reported and not cross-comparable across tools; the full-context baseline (~73% on LoCoMo) often beats memory tools and is shown as the honest control.
FACT axes export / temporal / governance were verified per-product from docs + repos (Kata x Cipher recon, 2026-06-14); 'self-reported' marks an axis confirmable only from the vendor's own docs.
